# Vault Movement

> Vault Movement (legal name Vault Movement Pvt Ltd), formerly Chennai Parkour, is a Fitness & Lifestyle Studio in Chennai, India, established in 2008. It runs coach-led strength, movement and lifestyle programmes for adults and kids. Tagline: Movement for Everybody.

## Key facts
- Name: Vault Movement (legal: Vault Movement Pvt Ltd). Formerly: Chennai Parkour. Established 2008, Chennai.
- Type: Fitness & Lifestyle Studio.
- Studios: City Studio · Ekkattuthangal — TS 69, Second Floor, SIDCO Industrial Estate, Ekkaduthangal, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600032. Coast Studio · Injambakkam, ECR — 2nd floor, No 41 & 42, East Coast Road, Cholamandal Artists Village, Injambakkam, Chennai 600115.
- Hours: both studios, every day, 6:00 AM – 9:00 PM.
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 99626 96859.
- Programmes: Vault 12 · Movement & Strength · Personal Training (PT Trio, PT 1:1) · Vault Kids (Toddlers, Under 10, Under 14) · More from Vault Movement.
- Method: The Vault — a library of 750+ movements built since 2008, with five coach-verified levels (Vault One to Vault Five). Member app: My Vault (app.vaultmovement.fit).
- Prices are not published. Every journey starts with an Experience Session; plans are shared on a call or on WhatsApp.
- Executive Coaches: Vishal Kumar, Vishwa Dayakaran, Vignesh Raghavan (18+ years each).
- Trusted to train TNCF, CISF, NSG and Tamil Nadu Fire & Rescue Services. Movement work for the Tamil films Chekka Chivantha Vaanam, Irumbu Thirai and Kanithan.

## Start here
- [Home](https://vaultmovement.fit/): overview, where to start, studios and hours
- [Your Journey](https://vaultmovement.fit/journey): Experience Session → Vault 12 → Movement & Strength → Personal Training
- [Experience Session](https://vaultmovement.fit/experience-session): the first visit — baseline assessment, coach consultation, programme match

## Programmes
- [Vault 12](https://vaultmovement.fit/programmes/vault-12): 12-week, coach-led starter for basic fitness, sustainable weight loss and strength
- [Movement & Strength](https://vaultmovement.fit/programmes/movement-and-strength): 6 days a week, 60-minute sessions, Vault One to Three
- [Personal Training](https://vaultmovement.fit/programmes/personal-training): PT Trio and PT 1:1
- [Vault Kids](https://vaultmovement.fit/kids): Toddlers, Under 10 and Under 14 batches
- [More from Vault Movement](https://vaultmovement.fit/more): Adaptive Movement, workshops, schools, corporate, armed forces, events, coach certification
